title: List
description: A bare enumeration — refereeing venues, review panels. These are not items: they have no date, no links of their own and no presets, so making each entry a file in data/ would be absurd. Each entry is one line of prose which may carry [text](url) links, exactly as an item's `long` does.

id.description: Matches the filename stem, and is what a preset section's `list` names.
